newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombia peso rises as banks set dollar shorts.
newsitem.headline: Colombia peso rises as banks set dollar shorts.

text.p: Colombia's peso gained 1.3 pesos to close at 1,106.4 against the dollar as banks moved to shorten dollar positions and export earnings flowed into the market.

Interbank dealers said the market was relatively stable and that the peso was still on an upward trajectory. Some of the influx of greenbacks was mopped up by pharmaceutical laboratories and vehicle assembly plants.
The peso opened at 1,107.7 and saw an intraday high of 1,105.7 and a low of 1,108. Dealers reported 316 trades worth a total $167 million.
